notes.title: New enemy types and animation fixes
notes.content:

- Adjusted animation speed for all characters
- Added a few new enemy types

notes.title: PATCH 24.February.2020
notes.content:
- Added autosave (every 5 minutes)
- Changed xp gain calculation (advanced enemies give you an increasing higher xp progress than early game enemies)
- Changed gold gain calculation (advanced enemies make you earn increasingly higher sums of gold than early game enemies)
- Rebalanced enemy defense
- Rebalanced enemy life
- Rebalanced warrior attack upgrade cost
- Rebalanced warrior speed upgrade cost
- Rebalanced crit chance upgrade cost
- Rebalanced crit multiplier upgrade cost
- Rebalanced golem speed upgrade cost
- Rebalanced plant speed upgrade cost
- Rebalanced wolf speed upgrade cost
- Rebalanced phoenix speed upgrade cost
- Rebalanced heal per second upgrade cost
